infomation_blocks.title: Company Overview - London-listed Luxury Real Estate Developer
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: Dar Global is a London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor, and asset manager creating high-quality communities, landmark destinations, and lifestyle-driven assets across premier global markets including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and London. The company spans premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment, and exclusive golf communities, owning, investing, developing, and operating high-end real estate for long-term value.

infomation_blocks.title: Company Statistics and Track Record
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: Dar Global reports 32 years of track record, $23B gross development value, 7 international markets, and 12+ global brand partners. Data points are indicative and aligned with disclosures as of Q3 2026.

infomation_blocks.title: News: Dar Global and The Trump Organization Launch $700M Qatar Destination
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: Dar Global and The Trump Organization marked the official launch of Trump International Simaisma, Qatar, at an exclusive event for international investors. Published Nov 19, 2026.

infomation_blocks.title: News: New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: Dar Global announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value of SAR 1 billion, expanding its Saudi Arabia portfolio. Published Nov 16, 2026.

infomation_blocks.title: News: Dar Global Capital Partners Dubai Investment Mandate
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed Dar Global, announced its strategic focus on deploying capital into high-value real estate opportunities in Dubai across a global investment mandate. Published Oct 26, 2026.

infomation_blocks.title: News: Trump Villas Simaisma Qatar Sales Open
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: Dar Global officially opened sales for its Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar, with unprecedented interest. Published Oct 07, 2026.

infomation_blocks.title: News: HY 2026 Revenue Growth and $23B GDV
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: Dar Global announced unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting 66% revenue growth as portfolio GDV reached $23 billion. Published Sep 30, 2026.

infomation_blocks.title: News: Gulf Asia Contracting Appointed for Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: Dar Global awarded the construction contract to Gulf Asia Contracting for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. Published Aug 06, 2026.

infomation_blocks.title: Asset Management - Dar Global Capital Partners
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. CTA: EXPLORE INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES at /investor

infomation_blocks.title: About DarGlobal
infomation_blocks.summarized_data: DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specializing in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, it connects global capital with curated luxury living across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond. CTA: WHY INVEST WITH DARGLOBAL at /why-invest
